import subprocess,json,shutil,hashlib,os,difflib,tempfile,tarfile,io,time
repo=Path('/Users/tdenisenko/code/logex')

root=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='logex-final-cached-head-',dir='/private/tmp'));base=root/'base';base.mkdir()
Path('/tmp/logex-final-cached-head-root.txt').write_text(str(root))
archive=subprocess.check_output(['git','archive','09a63f55'])
with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(archive)) as tar: tar.extractall(base,filter='data')
current=Path('crates/logex-storage/tests/ingestion_publication.rs').read_text()
adapter=current
start=adapter.index('impl Config {');end=adapter.index('// SyncEngine',start)
adapter=adapter[:start]+adapter[end:]
adapter=adapter[:adapter.index('#[test]\n#[ignore = "release cached-header')]
adapter=adapter.replace('''                    storage
                        .ingest_historical_batch(rows, &measured_headers[*first])
                        .unwrap();''','''                    if !rows.is_empty() {
                        storage.write_historical_batch(rows).unwrap();
                    }
                    storage.record_historical_floor(&measured_headers[*first]).unwrap();''')
adapter=adapter.replace('''                    storage
                        .ingest_canonical_batch(
                            rows,''','''                    if !rows.is_empty() {
                        storage.write_batch(rows).unwrap();
                    }
                    storage
                        .record_verified_canonical_state(
                            &anchor(header),''')
adapter=adapter.replace('''                            Some(&anchor(header)),
''','')
start=adapter.index('                    // Measure a publication boundary');end=adapter.index('            let elapsed = start.elapsed();',start)
adapter=adapter[:start]+'''                    storage.record_historical_floor(header).unwrap();
                }
            }
'''+adapter[end:]
adapter=adapter.replace('    let (headers, blocks) = fixture(&config);','    assert!(!config.durable_checkpoint, "original baseline has no explicit durable checkpoint API");\n    let (headers, blocks) = fixture(&config);',1)
fixture=base/'crates/logex-storage/tests/ingestion_publication.rs';fixture.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True);fixture.write_text(adapter)
manifest=base/'crates/logex-storage/Cargo.toml';manifest.write_text(manifest.read_text()+"\n[target.'cfg(target_os = \"macos\")'.dev-dependencies]\nlibc = \"0.2\"\n")
(root/'baseline-adapter.patch').write_text(''.join(difflib.unified_diff(current.splitlines(keepends=True),adapter.splitlines(keepends=True),fromfile='candidate/fixture.rs',tofile='baseline/fixture.rs')))
(root/'fixture.rs').write_text(current)
records=[{'kind':'build_environment','base':'09a63f555db19a03850ce5eba6f149957febaf3b','candidate':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'patch':subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--','crates/logex-storage/tests/ingestion_publication.rs'],text=True),'base_archive_sha256':hashlib.sha256(archive).hexdigest(),'adapter':(root/'baseline-adapter.patch').read_text(),'runner':Path(__file__).read_text(),'rustc':subprocess.check_output(['rustc','-Vv'],text=True),'baseline_dev_dependency':'libc 0.2 for process write counters; existing locked version, only dev edge added'}]
env=os.environ|{'CARGO_TARGET_DIR':str(repo/'target')}
try:
 for label,source in [('candidate',repo),('base',base)]:
  source_hashes={str(p.relative_to(source)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in source.glob('crates/**/*.rs')}
  command=['cargo','test','-p','logex-storage','--test','ingestion_publication','--release','--locked' if label=='candidate' else '--offline','--no-run','--message-format=json']
  start=time.monotonic()
  with (root/(label+'-build.log')).open('w')as log:r=subprocess.run(command,cwd=source,env=env,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=log)
  (root/(label+'-build.jsonl')).write_text(r.stdout)
  if r.returncode:raise RuntimeError(str(root/(label+'-build.log')))
  paths=[r['executable'] for line in r.stdout.splitlines() if (r:=json.loads(line)).get('executable')];assert len(paths)==1
  binary=root/(label+'-bench');shutil.copy2(paths[0],binary)
  with (root/(label+'-fixture-test.log')).open('w')as log:r=subprocess.run([str(binary),'storage_publication_preserves_rows_and_empty_block_progress','--nocapture','--test-threads=1'],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
  assert r.returncode==0, str(root/(label+'-fixture-test.log'))
  record={'kind':'build','revision':label,'binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'source_hashes':source_hashes,'command':command,'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-start};records.append(record)
  (root/'build-record.jsonl').write_text(''.join(json.dumps(r)+'\n' for r in records));print(label,'built and smoke-tested',flush=True)
finally:
 # A baseline build shares dependency artifacts; force later candidate crates fresh.
 for p in repo.glob('crates/**/*.rs'): os.utime(p,None)
print(root,flush=True)
